title: Creative Inquiry + Undergraduate Research (Clemson University)
description:
Creative Inquiry (CI) is Clemson's signature combination of undergraduate research, experiential learning, and cross-disciplinary teamwork. Each year roughly 4,500 undergraduates across every discipline join about 400 team-based, multi-semester research projects mentored by faculty. Students propose questions, design investigations, and present their findings — the central way to get involved in research at Clemson.
